verses.1: Similarly, women submit to individual men, so that some of them can also be persuaded by their words, and thus gain victory through the transformation that occurs in women themselves, without any need for reasoning.
verses.2: They feared that the darkness of fear would bring about a reversal of your situation.
verses.3: Whoever is involved in getting hair out from outside and wearing gold or silk clothes,
verses.4: But the person whose heart is hidden, who lives in a state of exhaustion and quietness, that person is truly magnificent before God.
verses.5: Thus, sometimes even the holy women who hoped for God would adorn themselves in accordance with His desires, while submitting to their own husbands.
verses.6: As Sarah spoke to Abraham, calling him “my master”; may she become a good mother and not fear anything or anyone.
verses.7: Men who live together in harmony, treating women with respect and kindness, as if they were weaker beings. They also give life to their fellow men, so that they won’t fail to fulfill your prayers.
verses.8: And the end is that all of them are equal in their desires; they are kind, loving, and generous. They are also humble and modest.
verses.9: Do not do evil instead of good, nor slander instead of truth. Instead, be righteous, for it is for this purpose that you were chosen to inherit righteousness.
verses.10: For he who wants to live loves and seeks good days. He avoids speaking evil words, and he refrains from lying.
verses.11: I will also eliminate evil and do good. I will seek peace and also drive away that evil.
verses.12: Because the eyes of a lord are focused on justice and righteousness; but his face is focused on doing evil.
verses.13: And who among you is the worst person who could harm you, if you become greedy for good things?
verses.14: But even if you suffer because of justice, that’s still better. Do not fear or be disturbed by their fear.
verses.15: But you have sanctified Christ in your hearts. Be always ready to listen to everything that those who accuse you say, regarding the hope that lies within you.
verses.16: But after fear and anxiety, they still possess goodness within themselves. This goodness is what will enable them to overcome those who try to destroy this goodness in Christ.
verses.17: For those who do good, if they truly desire to fulfill God’s will, they will suffer rather than do evil.
verses.18: For even Christ suffered for our sins, being righteous over the unjust, so that he might bring you to God. He died in body but rose in spirit.
verses.19: In which place he also proclaimed to those spirits in prison.
verses.20: They were once forced to do this when the God’s patience ran out during the days of Noah’s construction of the ark. Only eight souls survived; they were saved by swimming into the water.
verses.21: And that baptism which now saves you, is not a physical washing of wounds, but rather a revival of the good spirit into God’s kingdom, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ.
verses.22: Whoever is placed on the right side of God, leading messengers and armies to heaven.
